tools.name: assay_countries
tools.description: Countries covered by the Assay Systems procurement register, with the number of suppliers indexed in each.

tools.name: assay_search
tools.description: Search the register for a supplier (firm) by name or line of business. Returns names, countries, ids and endpoints.

tools.name: assay_supplier
tools.description: One supplier's record: contracts won, buyers, totals, exclusions and grants, with the source and licence.

tools.name: assay_line
tools.description: A line of business (what is bought) in one country: buyers, suppliers and totals.

tools.name: assay_contract
tools.description: One contract or award record from the register.

tools.name: assay_status
tools.description: When each source of the register was last read and built.

tools.name: assay_supplier_contracts
tools.description: All contract rows of one supplier with the buying office's contact, end dates and amounts. Needs an Enterprise Data key: X-API-Key header on the MCP request (https://assay-systems.com/api-key/#data).

tools.name: assay_line_contracts
tools.description: All contract rows of one line of business with the buying office's contact, end dates and amounts. Needs an Enterprise Data key: X-API-Key header on the MCP request (https://assay-systems.com/api-key/#data).

tools.name: assay_ending
tools.description: Contracts of one line that are still running, soonest end first: the next tenders to come. Needs an Enterprise Data key: X-API-Key header on the MCP request (https://assay-systems.com/api-key/#data).

tools.name: assay_solo
tools.description: Buyer × supplier pairs where the supplier won without a rival, locks and buyer shares; without country — the list of countries. Needs an Enterprise Data key: X-API-Key header on the MCP request (https://assay-systems.com/api-key/#data).
